headline: Top-Ranked Buckeyes Visit Longhorns in Week 2 Showdown
subhead: The nation's top two teams clash in Austin with identical 1-0 records and explosive offensive profiles.

xFactor.why: Jerrick Gibson leads the PCFL with 128 rushing yards and anchors a ground attack averaging 245 yards per game.

keyMatchup: Texas's top-ranked defense allowing 190 yards per game faces an Ohio State offense generating 455 yards per game behind Brock U Thomas's 293 passing yards.
body: Ohio State arrives ranked first in the power poll after a 42-19 win over Michigan, averaging 42 points and 455 total yards behind quarterback Brock U Thomas, who threw for 293 yards and a touchdown, and a ground game producing 236 yards per game with CJ Donaldson adding 83 yards. The Buckeyes defense allowed 295 yards per game, ranking fourth in the PCFL, with Will U Straton recording a sack and Earl Little securing an interception.

Texas matches them at No. 1 following a 37-14 road victory at Georgia, leading the PCFL in total defense at 190 yards allowed per game while the offense ranks third with 482 yards per game, split between 237 through the air and a league-best 245 on the ground. Arch Manning threw for 252 yards and three touchdowns, Ryan Wingo caught 80 yards, and Jerrick Gibson paced all rushers with 128 yards, while Liona Lefau notched two sacks to lead a disruptive front.
